datum: South straight parapet top on terminal straight panel, not the cornice lower down. The datum at (842,224.6) in this bay varies between y223 and 227. All pixel coordinates use the unresized 1080x823 original.

model_estimate: Use about 2.2m projected above neighbouring parapet (about 2.5m above local round lip), aperture lit height ~0.84m and top ~1.37m above the arch opening. Same-face head–sill has an approximate 0.65–1.05m physical range accounting for picking and perspective. Use ~1.8–2.8m as a massing estimate above nearby parapet; true elevation is not constrained to that interval by a single view.
depth: The photo is from below and toward the straight southern wall. The arch, rim and flat-roof datum lie at unequal plan depths, unknown focal length, working distance and rectification lens shift. Their apparent elevations are not survey heights, and the shallow arc of the visible skyline does not establish a closed cap. The interior and oblique photos demonstrate open sky.
other_image: city26-current + 2024-02-10 field post show three actual small arched front/raking openings; engineer23-drum shows the opposite side and actual sky. No solid geometry across roof opening.
